model: multinomial logistic regression over hashed sparse features, three heads (type 4, genre 10, video class 2)

features.title_and_artist: Unicode code-point n-grams n=1..4 with ^/$ boundaries (first 160 code points), ASCII word unigrams and bigrams; tagged per field and also untagged ('x') for shared n>=2
other: duration bucket (U unknown, L live, a<60s, b<150, c<330, d<600, e<1500, f<3600, g)
features.normalisation: NFKD, drop U+0300-036F, ASCII lowercase, whitespace collapse
features.hash: FNV-1a 32-bit over UTF-8, masked to 2^17 buckets
features.feature_scaling: binary, divided by sqrt(number of active features)

training.augmentation: one extra copy per row: artist blanked p=0.35, duration set unknown p=0.5, source blanked p=0.15 (rows kept only if changed)
training.artist_rows: every artist-table key added twice to the genre head (artist-only view and title-only view)

quantisation: per-head symmetric int8, scale = max|W|/127; biases float32

pipeline.site_rules: music sites -> music, podcast sites -> podcast, film/course sites -> video only, live duration -> music or live
